blocks.orig: Rufiji Explorers Camp is located just outside Nyerere National Park (formerly Selous Game Reserve), along the Rufiji River. The camp’s four ox-wagon rooms (two double, two twin) come with indoor sitting areas, flushing toilets, and outdoor showers under the stars – all facing the river from private viewing decks. Meals are fire-cooked (more like BBQ feasts and daily homemade bread!), served at communal tables, with sundowners on the dinner deck!
blocks.html: Rufiji Explorers Camp sits on the banks of the Rufiji River, just outside Nyerere National Park (formerly Selous Game Reserve). Its four ox-wagon rooms (two double, two twin) have indoor seating areas, flushing toilets and outdoor showers beneath the stars – and each looks out over the river from its own viewing deck. Meals are cooked over the fire (think BBQ feasts and fresh homemade bread every day!), served at shared tables, with sundowners on the dinner deck!
